why: Today's CI tooling, the recheck of 4908018f3: changes 1. Case (a) is fixed: on a fake clock with every call answering in 0.9 s over 99 skipped runs at the head, the gate stops at its 90 s deadline after 100 calls with exit 1 and no start line, and the report on a gate job that ended failure reads red and opens the ci-scheduled issue; at 0.3 s a call the same walk answers in 102 calls (K + 3). Case (b) is fixed: SC14 refuses continue-on-error on the gate step, on the job, and as an expression, and refuses a timeout-minutes given as an expression on the step or the job. Still open in the same class (the gate ends with no start and without failing): SC14 passes an if: on the decide step (if: false, or if: on the event) and an if: on the gate's checkout; a skipped decide step leaves the job success with an empty start, so the report reads stopped and opens nothing, as review1 showed for this verdict. lastGreen now finds main's run 43780996689 (head 30f9e076d) on the live API, and the gate's live read takes it as the last full run, 3 calls in 1.3 s.
note: Read-only apart from this row. Read every line of git diff e4b0d08e5..4908018f3 in gate.mjs, scheduled.mjs, scheduled.yaml and workflow-lint/scheduled.ts. Ran one at a time, Node 26.13.0: gate.test.ts 7, scheduled.test.ts 31, workflow-lint/scheduled.test.ts 138, all green. Plants by scratch scripts outside the branch, on lintScheduled over the real scheduled.yaml text: step continue-on-error, job continue-on-error, continue-on-error as an expression, step and job timeout-minutes as expressions, job limit 3 (all red); decide if: false, decide if: on the event, checkout if: false (green, missed); decide limit 1 minute (green, but a step limit ends the step failure, so it stays loud). The live reads were GETs only. No pnpm typecheck: the fix round ran it on this head.
